explanation: The QC table's nSig column heading changes from 'Sig (P<0.01)' to 'Sig (FDR<0.05)', the same significance call the rest of the app uses. deSummary[].nSig is now counted by the bundle writer as finite FDR < NSIG_FDR_THRESHOLD in the default-contrast table; qcTables only renders it. The macaque atlas has no nSig and keeps its own FDR/logFC DEG columns.
